summary: The static balanced-centroid realization is closed: every tested 32-D and 128-D geometry missed the recall gate before beating grouped exact, while the only prior real capture contained one unique row. The new 112-cycle DFlash oracle was screened but has one request and verifier top-1 only, so learned or frequency-aware routing still lacks the required representative dense top-10 target-verification trace.
next_action: Remain blocked without a GPU claim. Reactivate only when an already-admitted consumer durably emits one unseen 384-row target-verification step with draft IDs, dense top-10 IDs and values, request/depth mapping, and accepted-prefix decisions; then require a learned or frequency-aware router to clear 31/32 top-1 and 90% top-10 recall below the 1093.817 us grouped-exact floor.

typed_boundary.exact_need: 384 post-final-norm BF16 hidden rows, 384 proposed draft token IDs, dense top-10 IDs/values, request/depth mapping, and dense accepted-prefix decisions from one unseen target-verification step
typed_boundary.effect: Synthetic results can close this static realization but cannot establish production recall, accepted-prefix fidelity, model quality, or sampling support.
